# ghost/safari

Configurable iOS Chrome/browser smoke automation

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/safari
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/safari open_ghost_site --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/safari read_news --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/safari open_browser --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/safari open_safari --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/safari open_url --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/safari verify_page --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/safari read_news_action --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_ghost_site`: Open ghostinthedroid.com in the configured iOS browser
- `read_news`: Read headlines and article snippets from a text-friendly news site in iOS Chrome/browser
- `open_browser`: Launch the configured iOS browser
- `open_safari`: Launch the configured iOS browser; kept as a compatibility alias
- `open_url`: Open a URL in the active iOS browser
- `verify_page`: Verify expected text is visible in the iOS browser source
- `read_news_action`: Open a news site in iOS Chrome/browser and extract headlines plus article snippets
